title: ReplayMod-Pose-Fix
description: Fixes the issue where Shift presses and commands with poses such as /lay, /sit and /crawl are not displayed
body:
**This add-on resolves an issue in ReplayMod on the server where pressing the Shift key, as well as commands to adopt certain poses such as /lay, /sit and /crawl, were not recorded**

This add-on works only with the ReplayMod mod
